# Luredon

Fishing helper for World of Warcraft: Forever: double right-click to cast, automatic lures,
skill and session stats, catch log with records, zone catch tables and optional auction prices
via Auctionator. Download: https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/luredon

The full description is in [README.md](../README.md). Bug reports are welcome as issues.
